title: Authentication Login Audit Event Contract
description: Draft event contract for authentication login audit emission, source-backed by historical audit and authentication proof evidence. The first assurance slice uses this event to link interface behaviour, workflow state, audit record, observability signal, and future proof evidence by request identifier.
aiGuidance: Do not emit or rename this event without updating event semantics, audit semantics, and validators together.
ordering: after authentication decision, before response readiness is claimed, and before any proof evidence claims audit coverage
retryPolicy: retry only where duplicate audit events remain idempotent by request identifier and do not create conflicting authentication outcomes
dlqPolicy: failed audit emission is a blocking readiness finding, not silently discarded; proof evidence must fail closed if audit collection is missing
retention: retained according to audit-event retention policy once authored
failureSemantics: Missing collected audit evidence, missing request-id correlation, or mismatched proof-id correlation fails closed for any proof claim that depends on this event.
